d:
The Bucks defeated the Pacers, 110-102 tonight in Milwaukee. Tyler Herro finished with a team-high 23 points along with 10 rebounds and 7 assists for the Bucks, while Ryan Rollins tallied 19 points, 4 assists and 3 three pointers in the game. Tyrese Haliburton recorded 22 points, 9 assists and 6 rebounds. The Bucks improve their record to 1-3 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 2-2 for the season.
